item.title: Comprehensive Solutions for Corrosive Chemical Handling
item.description:
Engineered Plastic Chemical Pumps for Industrial Applications
#

Assoma offers a diverse selection of chemical transfer pumps constructed from high-performance engineering plastics, designed to withstand a broad spectrum of corrosive chemicals. These pumps are suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor environments, supporting operations such as chemical transfer, production processes, laboratory work, sampling, dosing, filtration, and chemical unloading.
